workarounds.note: the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it
every frontmatter value is quoted (a bare number or date would print empty)

maxWidth (CAP) is fitted to essay IV's title in each edition so the ellipsis follows a whole word; ellipsis-end cuts between letters and keeps a trailing space ('false …'), so other titles would still be cut mid-word
every header, footer and opener colour carries its hex beside its paletteId, because design slots never read the palette; repointing main-color leaves the built-in head blue
the colophon names no title in italics: its muted paragraph style has no italicColor, so an italic run would print in bodyText.italicColor, the ink

runtMinCharacters: 16 lets essay IV end on 'our minds.': at the default 20 both 'our minds.' and 'minds.' fall under the threshold, and the flat runtPenalty cannot prefer the two-word ending, so Knuth–Plass keeps the tighter first line and leaves 'minds.' alone
locale is the exact bundled code ('en-us' | 'es'): a region-tagged code such as 'es-ES' silently hyphenates as American English (gotcha hyphenation-locales)
